ar.text: لِنُحَاوِلْ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى. اِسْمَعِ السُّؤَالَ، ثُمَّ اِخْتَرِ الصُّورَةَ الْمُنَاسِبَةَ.

en.text: Let’s try again. Hear the question, then choose the matching picture.
Well done. You found the matching picture.

ar.text: رَتَّبْتَ الصُّوَرَ. لِنَسْمَعْ حِكَايَتَكَ بِهَذَا التَّرْتِيبِ.

en.text: You arranged the pictures. Let’s hear your story in this order.
Tap Next to continue the story.

ar.text: اِسْمَعِ الْكَلِمَةَ، ثُمَّ رَتِّبْ أَصْوَاتَهَا. لِإِزَالَةِ صَوْتٍ، اِضْغَطْ عَلَيْهِ.

en.text: Hear the word, then put its sounds in order. Tap a placed sound to remove it.
Well done. You built the word. Let’s hear it together.
Well done. You ordered the words. Let’s hear the sentence.

ar.text: لِنَسْمَعِ الْكَلِمَاتِ الَّتِي رَتَّبْتَهَا. يُمْكِنُكَ إِزَالَةُ كَلِمَةٍ بِالضَّغْطِ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ إِعَادَةُ تَرْتِيبِهَا.

en.text: Let’s hear the words you placed. Tap a placed word to remove it, then try another order.

en-cup.text: The book hides the cup. Where is it?

en-cat.text: The cat gets into the box by itself.

en-writer.text: Sam rolls the ball to Mia.

en-ending.text: Sam puts a soft blanket in the open box. The cat can choose.

ar-first-next-last.text: فِي هَذِهِ الصُّورَةِ ظَهَرَ الْكُوبُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.

en-first-next-last.text: Then Mia moves the book and finds the cup.

en-look-for-clues.text: The upright book hides the cup.

ar-notice-and-explain.text: أَضَافَ الْوَلَدُ غِطَاءً نَاعِمًا إِلَى الصُّنْدُوقِ.

en-notice-and-explain.text: Now the box has a soft blanket. What might the cat choose next?

en-polite-words.text: Sam waits until the door opens.

en-seed-entry.text: After several days, little leaves appear.

en-seed-practice.text: Mia puts the pot near the light and waters gently.

ar-seed-extend.text: ظُهُورُ الْأَوْرَاقِ يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ الْبَذْرَةَ نَبَتَتْ.

en-seed-extend.text: Several days later, the leaves are a clue she can see.

en-bridge-entry.text: The toy car crosses the bridge.

en-bridge-practice.text: She moves the supports closer and lines them up.

ar-bridge-extend.text: السَّيَّارَةُ فَوْقَ الْجِسْرِ. هَذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّهُ يَحْمِلُهَا.

en-bridge-extend.text: The car crosses. That is a clue that the bridge works for her toy.

en-colors-practice.text: She stirs red and yellow together.

ar-colors-extend.text: ظَهَرَ اللَّوْنُ الْبُرْتُقَالِيُّ عَلَى اللَّوْحَةِ قَبْلَ رَسْمِ الزَّهْرَةِ.

en-colors-extend.text: She says, I see orange after the mixing.

en-kindness-entry.text: Sam offers the piece to his friend.

ar-kindness-practice.text: وَضَعَتْ نُورَا الْقِطْعَةَ فِي الْفَرَاغِ فَاكْتَمَلَتِ الصُّورَةُ.

en-kindness-practice.text: Mia fits the piece into the gap.

ar-kindness-extend.text: يُقَدِّمُ عُمَرُ الْقِطْعَةَ وَيَقُولُ: تَفَضَّلِي هَذِهِ الْقِطْعَةَ.

en-kindness-extend.text: Sam offers the piece. He could say, Here you are.

en-tidy-entry.text: She finds two matching blue socks.

en-tidy-practice.text: She keeps each pair together and folds it.

ar-tidy-extend.text: الْجَوْرَبَانِ لَهُمَا اللَّوْنُ نَفْسُهُ وَالشَّكْلُ نَفْسُهُ.

en-tidy-extend.text: She uses color and shape as clues for matching.

en-letter-entry.text: Mia draws a sun on a card.

ar-letter-practice.text: وَصَلَتِ الرِّسَالَةُ عِنْدَ تَقْدِيمِ الظَّرْفِ إِلَى الصَّدِيقِ.

en-letter-practice.text: She gives the message to Sam by hand.

en-letter-extend.text: Sam sees the sun. What could he say in our conversation?

ar-rain-entry.text: نُورَا تَمْشِي مَعَ أُمِّهَا تَحْتَ الْمِظَلَّةِ.

en-rain-entry.text: She walks with Mom under the umbrella.

ar-rain-practice.text: جَهَّزَتْ نُورَا الْحِذَاءَ وَالْمِظَلَّةَ قَبْلَ الْمَشْيِ.

en-rain-practice.text: When rain starts, she and Mom prepare things for rain.

ar-rain-extend.text: قَطَرَاتُ الْمَطَرِ عَلَى الزُّجَاجِ تَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ الْمَطَرَ بَدَأَ.

en-rain-extend.text: Drops on the window are a clue that rain has started.

en-pack-entry.text: She stands with her bag and Mom by the door.

ar-pack-practice.text: تَخْتَارُ نُورَا الْأَشْيَاءَ قَبْلَ وَضْعِهَا فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ.

en-pack-practice.text: She chooses what she needs for her activity and leaves the ball.

ar-pack-extend.text: الْحَقِيبَةُ جَاهِزَةٌ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ بَعْدَ انْتِهَاءِ التَّجْهِيزِ.

en-pack-extend.text: She stands with Mom, and her light bag is ready.

en-picnic-entry.text: The family sits and shares the fruit.

en-picnic-practice.text: Mia helps put the things in the basket.

ar-picnic-extend.text: تُسَاعِدُ نُورَا أُمَّهَا فِي فَرْدِ الْبِسَاطِ.

en-picnic-extend.text: She helps spread the mat with Mom beside her.

en-boat-entry.text: The paper becomes a little boat.

en-boat-practice.text: Mom helps her with the folding.

ar-boat-extend.text: الْقَارِبُ فَوْقَ الْمَاءِ. هَذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّهُ يَطْفُو فِي هَذِهِ التَّجْرِبَةِ.

en-boat-extend.text: She sees it float in the basin. This is an observation from this try.

reserved.text: أَنَا مُدَرِّبَتُكَ. سَنَسْمَعُ الْحِكَايَةَ وَنَلْعَبُ بِالصُّوَرِ وَالْكَلِمَاتِ. سَأُسَاعِدُكَ خُطْوَةً خُطْوَةً.
اِضْغَطْ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَمَا تَحْتَاجُ مُسَاعَدَةً. سَأَشْرَحُ لَكَ الْخُطْوَةَ الَّتِي أَنْتَ فِيهَا.
سَنَتَوَقَّفُ الْآنَ. عِنْدَمَا تَكُونُ جَاهِزًا، نُكْمِلُ مَعًا.
لِنُكْمِلْ مِنَ الْخُطْوَةِ الَّتِي وَصَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا.
أَحْسَنْتَ. أَكْمَلْتَ حِكَايَتَكَ. يُمْكِنُكَ سَمَاعُهَا أَوِ اخْتِيَارُ حِكَايَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
هَذَا مَكَانُ الْمُدَرِّبِ. اِطْلُبْ مُسَاعَدَةَ الْمُرَافِقِ لِتَغْيِيرِ الْإِعْدَادَاتِ.
